summary: A rejected applicant can have their name removed from a published proposal while the proposal stays available.
realLife: After the Milky Way Peak applicant asked to disappear from the public review list along with the proposal, staff agreed to replace the personal name with a general location.
inGame: needs: the applicant’s removal request and staff’s publication decision.

turns.what: The editor substitutes a general description.
turns.pulledBy: Staff approves removing the personal name.

turns.what: The clerk explains which material stays public.
turns.pulledBy: The applicant seeks removal of the entire proposal.
turns.writesBack: The published proposal remains on the list..
